ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) mapping across approximately 90-95% of the surface, with high-intensity (white) localized clusters at the distal tips and along the trailing edge margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-contrast white clusters (geometric blobs) localized at the left and right distal tips. Scattered punctate white markers are distributed across the lower third of the fluke surface near the peduncle connection.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 85 degrees and a vertical pixel depth approximately 1/6th of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire continuous boundary; amplitude of peaks increases significantly towards the distal tips due to biological encrustation. Notable irregular jaggedness between the notch and mid-lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Complex curve exhibiting concavity starting from the median notch, transitioning to a linear-convex trajectory across the mid-lobe, and terminating in a sharp upward convex hook at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated at the extreme lateral points of both lobes. Scattered individual white circular anomalies across the central ventral plane.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible faint, non-linear white scratches and horizontal rake-like marks across the right lobe surface, cutting through the uniform dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular biological growth/encrustation on the trailing edges and tips; small white circular scarring likely from previous parasitic attachment across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-intensity transient pixels (water droplets/spray) overlaying the lower boundary of the fluke and peduncle region.
